observations: The commission itself discloses the author's headline values (World A 13/25, 1/10, 1/10, 7/25 and World B 1/5 mass). Those values are therefore PUBLIC and can never be re-used as blind pre-freeze preregistration. This court labels every use of them POST_DISCLOSURE_REPLICATION.

The commission records that the author corrected frozen expectations post-freeze (14/25 -> 19/25, 31/50 -> 41/50 and 7/50 -> 17/50). Amending a frozen expectation after observing output weakens the preregistration: the amended value is no longer a prediction but a post-hoc description.

F6J independently re-derives BOTH the old and the corrected values and shows the correction is arithmetically RIGHT (the uncovered share must be added). So the correction improves the arithmetic while weakening the preregistration. These are two different judgements and both are recorded.
F6J mitigates this by constructing 10 genuinely new worlds whose values were fixed and pushed before any candidate test output was read. Those are the genuinely preregistered science in this court.
